findings.finding: 虨 consistently denotes Yu’s eldest son/imperial grandson, later posthumously Prince of Nanyang. Xian is not supported. Captured Siku/Hu primary text explicitly annotates 虨甫斤翻; Bin is supported. Do not infer life years or alter Chinese.

保林蔣俊 is the mother of 虨, an Eastern Palace consort rank, not a forest administrator. The captured Hu note explicitly says 東宫女官品秩; conservative Baolin/consort wording is supported without inventing hierarchy.

Current Chinese prints 車武公, but the captured Siku/Hu witness in this exact ox-cart/deposition clause reads 東武公澹, and the current witness itself has 遣東武公澹 in later transfer. Duke of Dongwu is supported as witnessed English correction; 公 is duke. No canonical Chinese emendation approved.
中書令 is Director of the Secretariat, not Supervisor of the Masters of Writing; Sun Xiu and Chen Huai remain the named office holders.
癸未 reads guiwei, not guimao. This is a sexagenary-day transcription correction only, not a Gregorian date audit.
岳屢撻之 makes Pan Yue the flogger and Sun Xiu the victim. Existing literal has correct agent; idiomatic reverses it.

李庠 is Li Xiang, not Li Xiu. 妹婿 modifies Li Han alone; 天水 belongs to Ren Hui, 扶風 to Li Pan, 始平 to Fei Ta, 氐 to Fu Cheng. Do not extend brother-in-law relationship over the list or shift Tianshui to Li Han.

outsideScopeQA.zh: 允不之覺，開陣內之，下車受詔；
outsideScopeQA.finding: Existing both English fields say Yin dismounted to receive the edict. Subject remains Yun opening his ranks and dismounting; Yin then kills him in0321. Record for later bounded QA; not silently repaired here.

outsideScopeQA.zh: 相國倫收淮南王母弟吳王晏，欲殺之。
outsideScopeQA.finding: 母弟 denotes Yun’s younger brother by the same mother, not younger brother of Yun’s mother as existing English says. Separate future family/English QA.

outsideScopeQA.zh: 召中書監、侍中、黃門侍郎、八座皆夜入殿。
outsideScopeQA.finding: Same wrong Masters of Writing English phrase also occurs for 中書監, a different office. Do not mechanically equate 監 and令 or certify this unchanged phrase.
Dossier p120 name/evidence and mention at0336 use English Chen Huai but Chinese 陳准, whereas0316 has 陳淮. No identity or source emendation judgment is supplied by this bounded review.
